capabilities: Insert photos via the Google Photos Picker command
Link thumbnails back to the original Google Photos URLs
Customize inserted markdown with template variables
Insert album galleries (per legacy docs; limited by newer API)
extras: The README says the plugin is in maintenance mode and seeking a new maintainer. It also contains conflicting sections: a feature list stating codeblock galleries, album browsing and date queries were removed by Google API changes, followed by older usage instructions that still describe albums and codeblock galleries. Mobile use requires first authenticating on desktop and transferring settings.
problem: Obsidian cannot insert photos from a user's Google Photos library into notes without manual downloading and uploading.

relations.evidence: There is a plugin similar to this for Immich

requires.name: Google Cloud OAuth credentials (Client ID and Secret)

summary: Google Photos integration that embeds photos into notes via the Google Photos Picker API, downloading thumbnails locally and linking back to the originals.
